title: The 10 Best Jump Starters
subtitle: Portable lithium and lead-acid jump starters that start a dead battery without a second car, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A jump starter is a battery pack with clamps that starts your car on its own, no second vehicle needed. We ranked 10 best-sellers on rating, review volume and features (weather sealing, a boost or override mode for fully dead batteries, a 2-year warranty, a USB power bank and a status display). One warning: 'peak amps' isn't a standardized rating, so a cheap pack claiming 4000A isn't necessarily stronger than a NOCO rated 1000A. The engine size each maker lists is a better guide. They run from about $58 for AstroAI's S8 to $300 for NOCO's GB150.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

avoid.name: AIMAPOW Portable Car Battery Jump Starter 8000A Jump Box (A20)
avoid.flag: 8000A claim from a 0.9 lb, 7,200 mAh pack
avoid.verdict: A small pack sold on a giant number. For about $13 more, the AstroAI S8 is a similar size and lists modest, believable ratings with a 2-year warranty.
reasons: It claims 8000 amps peak from a 7,200 mAh battery in a 403 g (0.9 lb) pack. NOCO's 7.5 lb GB150 is rated 3000 A. A pack a tenth the weight claiming nearly three times the current isn't a believable figure.
It says it starts 'all gas engines'. Every reputable maker on this list names a maximum engine size, because a small pack can't start every engine.
It lists 8 AWG cables, much thinner than the #2 AWG cables on the Clore JNC660, yet claims more than four times its peak current.

buyers_guide.q: How many amps do I need?
buyers_guide.a: Ignore the peak amp number: there's no standard for it, and budget brands inflate it. Use the maker's rated engine size instead. A 4-cylinder car needs a pack rated for about 4.0L gas; V8 trucks and diesels need one rated for their engine size or bigger.
Lithium packs weigh 1 to 7 lbs and double as power banks. Lead-acid (AGM) boxes like the Clore weigh 15-20 lbs but handle repeated jumps and cold weather well, which is why shops use them.

buyers_guide.q: What does boost or force-start mode do?
buyers_guide.a: Most packs won't send power unless they detect some voltage in the car's battery, as a safety feature. If the battery reads near zero, boost mode overrides that check. Use it carefully and only with the clamps on the right terminals.

buyers_guide.q: How do I keep a jump starter ready?
buyers_guide.a: Recharge it every 3 months, and after every use. Keep it out of extreme heat on the dashboard. A dead jump starter is just a paperweight.

buyers_guide.q: Is a jump starter the same as a battery charger?
buyers_guide.a: No. A jump starter gives a short burst to crank the engine; the car's alternator then charges the battery. If the battery keeps dying, test it or charge it with a proper charger.
